title: Retry failed webhook deliveries with exponential backoff

change.title: Retry failed webhook deliveries with exponential backoff
change.description: Webhook deliveries used to be fire-and-forget: one failed POST and the customer never heard about the event. This retries server errors, timeouts and 429s up to six times with exponential backoff.

overview.summary: Adds a retry loop around webhook delivery, a small `backoff` module, and tests for the retry, give-up and no-retry paths.
overview.concerns: Retry semantics for 4xx, blocking the worker while it sleeps, and whether `Retry-After` is honoured.

files.summary: Retries a failed delivery up to six times
Delays and which statuses to retry

proposals.title: The worker sleeps for up to 31 seconds per delivery
proposals.body:
`await sleep(backoff(attempt))` holds this worker for the whole retry sequence (1 + 2 + 4 + 8 + 16 s). With 8 workers, a single slow customer endpoint can stall every other delivery.

Re-enqueue the delivery with a `runAt` instead of sleeping in-process.

proposals.title: `Retry-After` is parsed but never used
proposals.body: `retryAfter()` is exported but `deliver` ignores the header, so a 429 is retried after 1s regardless of what the endpoint asked for.

proposals.title: Add jitter so retries from many deliveries don't line up
proposals.body:
Every delivery that failed in the same outage retries at the same instants.

```suggestion
  return 1000 * 2 ** (attempt - 1) * (0.5 + Math.random() / 2);
```

proposals.title: The give-up log should say why
proposals.body: Include the last status so on-call can tell a 400 from six 503s: `{ endpoint, delivery, status: res.status, attempts }`.

proposals.title: Test that a 429 is retried
proposals.body: The tests cover 503 and 400 but not 429 or 408, the two client errors `isRetryable` treats as retryable.
